name: Warehouse Tariff Boundary Area Combination
combined_hypothesis: Even if visible energy cost is high, the real issue may be operator-controlled demand orchestration under an invalid denominator rather than an owner-capturable efficiency opportunity.
strategic_risk: Capital can be underwritten against the wrong variable, the wrong denominator and the wrong value-capture boundary at the same time.
tad_action: BUILD FAIR PEER SET + VALIDATE TARIFF EXPOSURE + VALIDATE CONTROL BOUNDARY + PROHIBIT ROI
allowed_language: A bounded strategic framing is admissible: the cost story may be tariff- and boundary-driven while area remains the wrong comparison basis.
tests: warehouse acceptance bundle should surface this combination candidate when tariff, boundary and comparison remain unresolved
combination must require run-level adjudication before downstream strategic use
